reason: V1 used a 1e-3 acceptance cutoff absent from frozen protocol and compared stored BF16-factor runtime to FP32 dense matrix projected through basis, so quantization residual was misclassified as operator-parity failure. This was not a runtime mismatch.
retained_observations: V1 relative-L2 0.00163–0.001675 and cosine >0.999998 remain as quantization diagnostics only.
